abstract: Stack-agnostic audit skill for client-trust and state-authority flaws, designed for AI agents and LLMs. Classifies every value a server stores by its only valid source (identity, entitlement, value, lifecycle state, derived, external fact, intent) and runs fifteen universal checks against every path that changes state: origin, permission, scope, bounds, transition, replay, concurrency, external claim, reach, parallel paths, enforcement, abuse rate, revocation, fail closed, and response. Self-contained: it requires no other skill or tool. Runs as a full audit, a spot check on one endpoint or diff, and a trust table in the plan before a write endpoint is built. It scans search-first and traces high-consequence paths in full, writes its reports to neuroforge/audit/ as it works, briefs the developer, and never changes project code until told to proceed.
